targets.queryText: SELECT (ts/86400)*86400 AS t, sum(status_code=200) AS ok, sum(status_code=401) AS failed FROM audit WHERE ts >= $__from/1000 AND ts < $__to/1000 AND action IN ('auth.login','auth.verify_otp','admin.login') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
